mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_idempotent (idempotent_key, merchant_id, biz_type, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{idempotentKey}, #{merchantId}, #{bizType}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_idempotent SET status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey}
UPDATE inventory_idempotent SET status = 'PROCESSING', error_msg = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey} AND status = 'FAILED'
